MatchCreateIn.description:
A player's own match submission.

The field names are ``validate_match``'s argument names, so its issues
name the request fields. A missing game target means 11, a missing
scoring type means side-out, and a missing best-of is inferred from
the games. Each team takes at most ``MAX_TEAM_ENTRIES`` codes and the
games at most ``MAX_GAME_ENTRIES`` scores.
MatchCreateIn.title: MatchCreateIn

MatchFormat.description:
Singles or doubles.

The values are the two base values of ``open_engine.RatingFormat``. The
engine's doubles categories (mixed, men's, women's) are not stored here:
#44 derives them from the players.
MatchFormat.title: MatchFormat

MatchOut.description:
A match, its teams, and its games, as the signed-in Account sees it.

``my_team`` is the viewer's own team, null when the viewer's Player did
not play in the match. ``my_decision`` is the latest confirm or dispute
this player recorded on the match, ``none`` when they recorded none or
did not play. A repeated decision is not recorded again, so confirming
again after a dispute that a moderator resolved still shows
``dispute``. An organizer's confirmation is not a player decision: a
player who confirms as a member of the match's Event Organizer still
shows ``none``. For a participant, ``confirmed_by_team`` says whether
a player on each team recorded a confirmation (a dispute is not a
confirmation); it is null for anyone else. A confirmation still shows
in ``confirmed_by_team`` after the same player disputes, since a
recorded decision is never withdrawn. It counts player confirmations
only: a match confirmed by an organizer or a moderator, or a
correction, can be confirmed with both false, so read ``status`` for
whether the match is confirmed. ``created_at`` is when the match was
submitted.
MatchOut.title: MatchOut

MatchStatus.description:
Where a Match is in confirmation.

Only ``record_match`` (the initial status) and the services in
``apps.matches.workflow`` set it.
MatchStatus.title: MatchStatus

MyPlayerOut.description:

Returned only to that Account. Empty optional text fields are ``""``.

required (issue #215).
MyPlayerOut.title: MyPlayerOut

PlayerCreateIn.description:
A new Player for the signed-in Account.

``birth_year`` and ``birth_month`` take JSON integers only: a boolean,
a numeric string, or a float is refused, as ``Player.clean_fields``
refuses them.

``birth_year``, ``birth_month``, and ``gender_division`` are read only
when the session holds no details from signup (ADR 0017, issue #215),
and are then required; held details are used instead. ``gender_division``
is ``mens`` or ``womens``. Optional text fields left out or null are
empty. Unknown keys are refused.
PlayerCreateIn.title: PlayerCreateIn

PlayerProfileOut.description:
A player as another signed-in Account sees them.

``city`` and ``region`` are null when the player's
``city_region_visibility`` hides them from the viewer, and when they
are empty, so the answer never tells the two apart.
PlayerProfileOut.title: PlayerProfileOut

Changes to the signed-in Account's own Player.

Only the fields sent change. Null clears an optional text field
(``legal_name``, ``city``, ``region``); the display name, birth year,
birth month, and gender division cannot be cleared. ``gender_division``
is ``mens`` or ``womens``.
``privacy`` changes the settings it names. Unknown keys are refused.

get.description: Return the Account that the session token or session cookie belongs to.

post.description:
Submit a match you played in. It counts as your team's confirmation.

The match stays pending until a player on the other team confirms it.
Players are given by OPEN Code. A missing game target means 11, a
missing scoring type means side-out, and a missing best-of is inferred
from the games.

get.description:
One match you played in, by its OPEN Code, in any status.

Anyone who did not play in the match gets 404, as for an unknown code.

parameters.description: An OPEN Code for a match. Any case, with or without hyphens and the prefix.
parameters.name: code

schema.title: Code

post.description:
Confirm a match you played in.

A pending match becomes confirmed once a player on each team confirms
it. Confirming again changes nothing. A disputed or voided match
cannot be confirmed (409). Anyone who did not play in the match gets
404, as for an unknown code.

parameters.name: code

post.description:
Dispute a match you played in. A moderator then reviews it.

Disputing again changes nothing. A voided match cannot be disputed
(409). Anyone who did not play in the match gets 404, as for an
unknown code.

get.description:
The pending matches waiting for your confirmation, newest first.

A match is listed while it is pending, you played in it, and nobody on
your team has confirmed it yet. Once you or a teammate confirms it,
your team is done and it leaves the list. A match you submitted is not
listed, since submitting confirms it for your team.

The signed-in Account's own Player, with every profile field and
privacy setting. 404 when the Account has no Player.

patch.description:
Change the signed-in Account's own profile fields and privacy settings.

Only the fields sent change. The gender division can change between
divisions but cannot be cleared (422). Both kinds of change apply
together or not at all: a 422 on either changes nothing. Each kind
that changes records one Audit Event (profile changes by field name
only). 404 when the Account has no Player.

post.description:
Create the signed-in Account's Player.

The Account's own email address must be verified (403 otherwise), and
an Account has one Player (409 for a second). The birth year and month
and the gender division come from the details held at signup in this
session (ADR 0017, issue #215); the body's are used only when the
session holds none, and are then required. The held details are
removed once the Player exists (on a 409 too), so a create refused for
any other reason can be retried. A player under 13 is refused with a
fixed 422, and the refusal holds for the session, as at signup: every
later create in it gets the same 422, and so does a signup after
logout (ADR 0017).

get.description:
Find players by the start of a word in their display name.

For picking an opponent or partner. Players whose Account is inactive
never appear. Limited per Account to 30 searches a minute and 300 a
day; past that the answer is 429 with a Retry-After header.
